entry.title: What is Sterek?
entry.summary:
Author: ultimate_Cheesecake

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 13Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 1

Summary: Sterek is the fan-favorite ship between Stiles Stilinski and Derek Hale in MTV's Teen Wolf, being the 6th most popular ship on AO3 with over 60,000 fics as of 2026. Fandom spaces tend to prioritize queer--particularly male--ships already, but there are many reasons why Sterek in particular was so popular. For one, Stiles and Derek were fan favorite characters, and he and Derek were some of the only characters without designated love interests. They were both conventionally attractive (as was everyone on the show) and seemed to fit popular tropes such as "opposites attract" and "enemies to lovers." Mostly though, they were just there at the right place at the right time. Slash, or fan fiction about same-sex pairings, had been exploding in popularity and even gaining mainstream attention, and the flames of fan excitement were only stoked higher by show-runner and actor encouragement.
